devdoc.details: Implementation of the {IPrivacyMining} interface This contract will conduct the privacy mining program all the asset pools deployed in the SMASP All the shielded asset pools in SMASP will have a corresponding reward pools in PrivacyMining contract, identified by their `assetId`s Each reward pool will run in two phases: In Phase I: Virtualtokens called vouchers will be distributed In Phase II : Silent tokens will be distributed as rewards

IneligibleUser(uint256,address).details: Thrown when a user ineligible to participate in a given reward pool accesses a mutable function

InvalidAmount().details: Thrown when the amount passed to a function is ZERO or invalid

InvalidPhase(uint256,uint256,uint256).details: Thrown when a function is accessed during the wrong phase

RewardPeriodFinished(uint256,uint256,uin.details: Thrown when the deposit/stake functions are called upon a reward pool after it's reward period has ended

RewardPeriodOngoing(uint256,uint256,uint.details: Thrown when the pool is upgraded (phase/allocPoint) when its exisiting reward period is ongoing

params._allocPoint: : reward allocation point for the reward pool Lets the owner of the pool add a new reward pool to PMC or upgrade a reward pool from phase one to two Emits the event {LogRewardPoolAdded} denoting the _assetId, _phase and _allocPoint of the rewardPool Requirements: - a corresponding asset pool in SMASP should exist for provided `_assetId` - `_phase` must either be 1 or 2 - The rewardPool's initial phase must be 1 less than `_phase`

claimRewardsFromPool(uint256).details: See {IPrivacyMining-claimRewardsFromPool} -> lets a user claim rewards if it has been accumulated

params._assetId: : Assset id of asset reward pool Note: Doesn't pay out the reward if user has accumulated zero reward in the given pool Emits a {LogRewardPaidByPool} event indicating the paid reward Updates the reward parameters of the reward pool Requirements: - user's phase in the reward pool should match reward pool's current phase

constructor.details: Sets the values for {SILENT} token and {SMASP} contract Both of these values are immutable: they can only be set once during construction Requirements: `_silentToken` and `_smaspContract` cannot be the zero address

params._amount: : Deposit amount of user in SMASP to be registered for the pool Updates the pool balance of the pool and user based on `_amount` Emits a {LogDepositToPool} event Requirements: - can only be called by SMASP contract - rewardPool for `_assetId` must be in phase I - reward period for phase I must not have completed already
params._assetId: : Assset id of asset reward pool in SMASP
params._user: : Assset id of asset reward pool in SMASP

getPendingRewards(uint256,address).details: Fetches the pending rewards of a user w.r.t. a reward pool

params._assetId: : Asset id of asset reward pool in SMASP

getPhaseInfo(uint256).details: Fetches the state of a phase in PMC

getRewardPoolInfo(uint256).details: Fetches the information of an asset reward pool in PMC

params._assetId: : Asset id of asset reward pool in SMASP

getRewardPoolPhase(uint256).details: Fetches the current phase of a reward pool in PMC

params._assetId: : Asset id of asset reward pool in SMASP

getUserPoolInfo(address,uint256).details: Fetches the information of a user w.r.t. a reward pool in PMC

params._assetId: : Asset id of asset reward pool in SMASP

lastRewardApplicableTime(uint40).details: Computes the last reward claimable time for a reward pool

massUpdatePoolRewardVariables(uint256[]).details: Updates all the reward variables of reward pools in a given phase

params._assetIds: : Array of assetId of all reward pools currently in `_phase` Called whenever a new reward pool is added to the PMC {Func: addRewardPool} OR the allocPoint for an existing reward pool is updated {Func: updateRewardPoolAllocations} This is because the rewards for all pools is affected by the above two actions

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions anymore. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby removing any functionality that is only available to the owner.

setRewardEmissionRate(uint256,uint128).details: Lets the owner update the emissionRate for a phase in PMC

params._phase: : one of the two global phases of reward pools in PMC
params._rewardEmissionRate: : amount of vouchers (`_phase` == 1) or silent rewards (`_phase` == 2) to be distributed per second in PMC Emits the event {LogUpdateRewardEmissionRate} denoting the newly updated reward emission rate for the `_phase` NOTE: Owner whould update all the reward pools with the function: {massupdatePoolRewardVariables} before calling this function

params._amount: : Amount of Silent tokens to be staked Lets user stake their Silent tokens to a reward pool - _amount cannot be zero - reward pool must be in phase 2 - the current reward period shouldn't have completed - the contract must be in unpaused state - the user must have participated in phase 1 of the reward pool:   UserPoolState.phase should not be zero - the user must have collected voucher rewards in phase 1 Updates the balance of user and the pool based on `_amount` Emits a {LogSilentStakedToPool} event indicating the staked amount
params._assetId: : Assset id of asset reward pool

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

params._amount: : Amount of Silent tokens to be unstaked Lets user(caller) unstake their Silent tokens from a reward pool Requirements - reward pool must be in phase 2 - `_amount` cannot be less than user's total stake in the pool - user must be in phase 2 for the given reward pool Updates the balance of user and the pool based on `_amount` powered by user's total voucher balance Transfers `_amount` Silent tokens from contract to the user Emits a {LogSilentUnstakedFromPool} event indicating the updated balance
params._assetId: : Assset id of asset reward pool

updatePoolRewardVariables(uint256).details: Updates the reward variables of a reward pool

updateRewardPoolAllocations(uint256,uint.details: Lets the owner update the allocation points for a reward pool

params._newAllocPoint: : reward allocation point for the reward pool Updates the reward pool variables Emits the event {LogUpdateRewardPool} denoting the _assetId and _newAllocPoint of the rewardPool Requirements: - reward pool's phase must match provided `_phase` NOTE: Owner should call the function {massupdatePoolRewardVariables} before calling this function whenever this function is called Maybe a pre-requisite should be that the
params._phase: : expected phase of the reward pool

ACC_SILENT_PRECISION.details: Stores the precision points for SILENT token

ACC_VOUCHER_PRECISION.details: Stores the precision points for Voucher virtual tokens

GLOBAL_REWARD_PERIOD.details: Stores the reward period for reward pools in both the phases

TREASURY.details: Address of the treasury wallet that gets funded with SILENT rewards for PMC and from which rewards are re-distributed

phaseInfo.details: Maps the phase (1 or 2) to the struct PhaseInfo

rewardPoolInfo.details: Maps the assetId of an asset to the struct RewardPool

userPoolInfo.details: Maps a user address and assetId to the struct UserPoolInfo Used for storing user's state information w.r.t. the reward pool for `assetId`
